    Concurrency¶

    rn_forge.web.concurrency ¶

    ETag codecs and If-Match checks for optimistic concurrency.

    Version mismatches produce 412, required missing preconditions produce 428, and malformed validators produce 400. Version codecs accept weak validators and If-Match: * only.

    ANY_ETAG = '*' module-attribute ¶

    If-Match: * — matches any current representation (RFC 9110 §13.1.1).

    DEFAULT_CODEC = EntityVersionETagCodec() module-attribute ¶

    The codec :func:check_precondition uses when the caller names none.

    ETagCodec ¶

    Bases: Protocol

    Formats and parses the ETag validator carried in If-Match.

    format(*, entity_id, version) ¶

    Return the ETag validator for an entity at a version.

    parse(raw) ¶

    Parse a validator into (entity_id or None, version).

    Raises:

    Type Description
    MalformedPrecondition

    raw is not a validator this codec emits.

    EntityVersionETagCodec ¶

    W/"<entity_id>:<version>" — the default.

    Carrying the entity id catches a client replaying a precondition from a different entity, which the version alone cannot.

    The entity segment is deliberately any run of characters that is not a colon or a quote, not a UUID pattern: integer and slug primary keys are both real, and rn_forge.django.BaseModel does not have a UUID pk. That relaxation is intentional.

    format(*, entity_id, version) ¶

    Return W/"<entity_id>:<version>".

    Raises:

    Type Description
    MalformedPrecondition

    entity_id renders with a : or ", which would produce a validator this codec cannot parse back.

    parse(raw) ¶

    Parse W/"<entity_id>:<version>" into (entity_id, version).

    VersionETagCodec ¶

    W/"<version>" — carries no entity identity.

    For models without a stable public id to put in the validator. It cannot catch a precondition replayed from a different entity; prefer :class:EntityVersionETagCodec where an id is available.

    format(*, entity_id, version) ¶

    Return W/"<version>". entity_id is accepted and ignored.

    parse(raw) ¶

    Parse W/"<version>" into (None, version).

    check_precondition(raw_if_match, *, current_version, entity_id=None, codec=DEFAULT_CODEC, required=False) ¶

    Raise unless the client's precondition matches the current state.

    Deliberately strict about the validator's syntax: anything it cannot parse is a 400, never a crash.

    is_not_modified(if_none_match, etag) ¶

    Return whether etag satisfies an inbound If-None-Match (RFC 9110 §13.1.2).

    For a GET/HEAD whose caller already holds a cached representation: a match means the caller sends 304 with no body and the ETag repeated (RFC 9110 §15.4.5). Comparison is weak — a leading W/ is ignored on both sides — unlike :func:check_precondition's If-Match, which RFC 9110 requires to compare strongly by default; ETags in this kit are always weak, so the distinction is moot here but the rule is still the caller's to get right for a strong validator from elsewhere.

    Parameters:

    Name Type Description Default
    if_none_match str | None

    The raw If-None-Match header value, or None.

    		 required
    etag str

    The resource's current ETag validator.

    		 required

    Type Description
    bool

    True when if_none_match is *, or any validator in its
    bool

    comma-separated list weakly matches etag.
